profile_text.body:
Pegasystems Inc is a public company headquartered in Waltham, Massachusetts, traded under the ticker PEGA and registered with the SEC under CIK 0001013857. Its site says it has worked with large organizations since 1983. The company describes itself as a leading AI-powered platform for enterprise transformation, used to automate workflows, personalize customer experiences, and modernize legacy systems.

On its own account, Pega's AI work centers on governance and human oversight. It says its AI agents operate with context, compliance, and human oversight from the start, and that customers can orchestrate an agentic workforce end to end. It names Pega Platform as the product where AI is unified and governed for mission-critical work, and Pega Blueprint as an AI-powered workspace that brings business and IT together for design and production rollouts. The company says its architecture is intended to support scale and continuous adaptation.

The record shows no products tracked for the company and no MCP servers. Its legal exposure is recorded in Massachusetts, with 191 matters.
